status_note: Segment (a1) projection of the Funcdata symbol query channel: Database-level Scope::queryContainer/queryProperties/isReadOnly/queryByName behind Funcdata::{query_container_parent_scope,query_properties_parent_scope,is_scope_read_only/query_name_parent_scope}, populated through the production addSymbol/addRange/removeRange/setPropertyRange/findCreateScope paths. 18 records byte-identical on both sides. Overall UNTESTED: the production driver does not populate arch.symboltab yet (segment a0 owns the .rodata DAT data source) and ActionConstantPtr does not consume the channel yet (segment b), so link_symbol_reference still falls back to the symbol_table name proxy in production runs.

analysis_options.api: Real BfdArchitecture (C++) / Funcdata+Database+Architecture channel (Rugra): getScopeLocal()->getParent()->queryContainer / Scope::queryProperties / Scope::isReadOnly / Scope::queryByName and the Funcdata channel equivalents; symbols/ranges/property-ranges installed through production addSymbol/addRange/removeRange/setPropertyRange/findCreateScope paths; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.ghidra_funcdata: GetStr (0x36d0, size 0) from readLoaderSymbols("::"), identity hard-verified on the oracle side
analysis_options.rugra_scope: fresh Database::new(false) + Architecture{symboltab} + Funcdata::new("GetStr",0x36d0,0) with set_arch; queries go through Funcdata::{query_container_parent_scope,query_properties_parent_scope,query_name_parent_scope}
analysis_options.ir: no P-code IR involved; pure symbol-database query layer

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: queryContainer/queryProperties return the scope-owned SymbolEntry (Rugra: by-value QueryContainerHit projection); queryProperties' flags is an out-parameter folded from getAllFlags / mapped|addrtied|persist|getProperty / getProperty alone (database.cc:1269-1280)
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: mapScope picks the base scope (empty resolvemap or miss falls back to the querying scope, database.cc:3188/3195); stackContainer walks parent links innermost-first with findContainer before inScope per scope, discovery returns a NULL entry and stops the walk (database.cc:943-962)
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters in the query layer; the readonly bit is folded into symbol flags ONCE at addMap time (database.cc:1153) — install order decides, later property ranges never contaminate
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: findContainer takes the smallest entry containing [addr,addr+size); needexacthit compares entry->getAddr()==rampoint by byte address (coreaction.cc:1160); char-array exception checks TYPE_ARRAY metatype then base isCharPrint (coreaction.cc:1153-1159)
